_comment: Deadlines synced into Google Calendar by ~/bin/coursecal.
Every entry cites the page it came from. Only add a date a source states;
if a date is TBD, leave it out rather than guessing — a wrong date on a
calendar is worse than a missing one.
Refreshed weekly by the Monday cron (see ~/.hermes/course-deadlines/README.md).
Deliberately NOT included: EECS 489 midterm (2026-10-23 09:00) already sits
on rsymonds@umich.edu as 'EECS 489 - Midterm'; duplicating it is noise.
